decisions.reason: Placing images at the beginning of every chapter does not change the existing editorial-review goal, selected images, mapping basis, or review criteria.
The chapter and cover image placement decision does not affect removal of the title's literal newline artifact.
The source message's separate cover-image decision is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE event with a cover image count of one.
Image placement does not alter the manuscript-polishing objective or the approved passage rewrites.
The specific placement of chapter and cover images does not change the existing general paperback-publishing guidance requirement.
